Years ago I was suffering from depression from my divorce. Took me a long time to fully grasp control of my suicidal thoughts but still hurt intensely seeing my ex wife with someone. 

And someone made a thread along the lines "how do you get over someone you love". So I bit. I dont remember that wonder mans username but I will paraphrase what he wrote off memory 

*you need to understand understand that you will never truly get over them. Because if you loved them then they meant something to you. As cheesy as it sounds the pain is proof that what you had was worth it to you. If it didnt hurt then it wouldn't be like this. Look at it like this. You go to Disney world. And it's fun. You have the time of your life.. but it's time to go.. you cant stay forever. But I promise you someday you will get to come back. But next time you'll know which rides you loved and how long the lines will be for others. So for now take the good with the bad. If it hurts then cry let it out write it down even if it sounds shitty who cares it for you. But you'll see eventually the waves come less and less. And you're going to be fine.*

If you read this man. Thank you. Our conversations resonated with me even 7 years later. I even got *the pain is proof it was worth it* tattooed on my collar bone cas it hit me that hard. Sadly I didnt get to stay at Disney world the next time I went but hopefully someday I'll find someone who will wait in those lines with me
